description: Commission of Elections - The List of 64 Political Parties to be recognized for the purpose of Elections under the Parliamentary Elections, Act No. 1 of 1981
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice published under Section 7(4)(b) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, containing the official list of political parties recognized for election purposes by the Election Commission. It directly concerns electoral processes and party registrations, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7). While it names the Election Commission members, this is incidental to the primary electoral administrative function, and it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a government hybrid type.
